name: Majiten ~Maji de Tenshi o Tsukuttemita~
original_name: マジてん 〜マジで天使を作ってみた〜
source:
Create your own angel from five archetypes and spend your days as you like with them. Brought to you by the creative force behind the Ore no Yome series, Majiten is bringing the romance back. Earn money and go on dates. Your every decision affects the angels, design their wardrobe and direct your relationship. The game comes with an easy mode, so you can choose scenarios. For example, if you want things to stay light and fluffy, you can just choose the simple mode to get rid of the heavy scenes. And when your Love Points with your angel reaches a certain level, you'll be in for some special service scenarios.

[from [url=https://www.play-asia.com/majiten-maji-de-tenshi-wo-tsukutte-mita-limited-edition/13/70548v]PlayAsia[/url]]
translation:
从五个原型中创造你自己的天使，并与他们一起度过你喜欢的日子。Majiten由Ore no Yome系列背后的创造力为你带来，将浪漫带回来。赚钱然后去约会。你的每一个决定都会影响天使，设计他们的衣柜并指导你们的关系。游戏配有简单模式，因此你可以选择场景。例如，如果你想让事物保持轻盈蓬松，你可以选择简单模式来摆脱沉重的场景。当你与天使的爱情点达到一定水平时，你将进入一些特殊的服务场景。

[来自[url=https://www.play-asia.com/majiten-maji-de-tenshi-wo-tsukutte-mita-limited-edition/13/70548v]PlayAsia[/url]]
